repairs.proof: Receipt scope and every typed dependency bind exact workspace, owner and subject; cross-workspace, cross-owner and cross-subject references fail closed.
Friendly customer_private and operator_private labels map once to person_private and delivery_team_private; only canonical audiences enter the authority envelope.
Every dependency names an allowed authority kind, UUID record, version, SHA-256 fingerprint, observation time and complete canonical scope; exact current authority readback is required.

fail_closed_cases: missing workspace, owner, subject or receipt identity
cross-workspace, cross-owner, cross-subject, cross-audience or cross-purpose dependency
version or fingerprint no longer current

determinism.fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical normalized envelope bytes

bounded_claim: R7 proves a local authority envelope and runtime-independent validation contract. It does not alter R5, query a live authority table, prove database currentness, change RLS, encrypt receipt content or connect a producer or caller.
